sources.quote: I've noticed more empty storefronts along Lakeshore lately, and it does make the neighborhood feel a bit quieter than it used to. I hope we can find ways to support local businesses and keep the area vibrant.

sources.quote: I've noticed more empty storefronts around Grand Lake lately—it's tough to see. As a baker, I know how much foot traffic matters, and when shops sit vacant, it hurts everyone.
